body: Weywot, satellite of Quaoar; primary quantities remain distinct
status: research-only targeted orbit-methods/results audit; no parameter, image, map, mesh, scene, dossier or codec adoption
title: Beyond Point Masses. V. Weywot’s Non-Keplerian Orbit
rights: Specific record CC BY-NC-SA4.0; not CC BY4 or blanket native-image permission. No figure embedded.
observationAndMethods: HST re-reduction differs from earlier astrometry by up to 100 mas; author cross-validation favours their pipeline, not independently reproduced.
Text describes five archival epochs but also six archival detections; retain counting crosswalk open. Two proximity non-detections excluded rather than modelled.
Six new WFC3 epochs in programs17315/17417 yield five astrometric epochs. Adopted1mas telescope and3mas occultation floors are assumptions, not new app calibration.
Three early occultations average north/south circular-limb positions; last uses an elliptical fit. These do not independently establish local topography.
MultiMoon/emcee13-parameter non-Keplerian model includes two constant primary photocentre offsets; primary17.752h spin is not moon spin. Higher harmonics omitted.
No resolved Quaoar albedo map available in this analysis; Pluto/Charon comparisons do not authorize analog skins.
dataset: https://doi.org/10.17909/ex7s-3w78 linked by paper; not fetched/reprocessed in this preparation.

tableResults.status: research preparation only; no catalogue, dossier, image, model, codec or physical parameter adopted
tableResults.scope: Targeted HTML Table 2, Section III.2 and IV; no figures visually inspected, posterior/code/raw astrometry not reproduced
tableResults.epochFrame: Fitted angles J2000 ecliptic, Quaoar-centric JD2454000.0 (2006-09-21 12:00 UT); derived RA/dec J2000 equatorial. Not current registered geometry.
tableResults.uncertaintyConvention: Arrays median, lower and upper deviations; publisher 16th/84th posterior percentiles, not independently verified accuracy.
tableResults.massPrior: Both fits impose Weywot Gaussian mass prior mean2.4e18kg sigma1.2e18kg based on then-in-preparation165km diameter and500–1500kg/m3 density assumptions. Posterior2.4(-1.1,+1.2)e18 /2.5(-1.2,+1.2)e18 is not independent mass measurement. Preserve later2026 smaller shape and historical tidal alternatives.
tableResults.primaryAssumptions: c-axis545km, spin17.752h; volumetric549km normalizes J2R2. These are primary conventions, not moon dimensions/temperature/chemistry.
tableResults.polePrior: Constrained primary pole Gaussian ecliptic12.6/331.46deg sigma3deg inflated ring-model uncertainty; unconstrained uniform. Ring-to-equator assumption and circular-ring eccentricity/warp biases remain model limits.
limits: Authors prefer constrained physical interpretation despite poorer fit; unconstrained high J2 may absorb time-varying photocentre offsets. Undiscovered moons/massive disk are hypotheses, not discoveries.
Constant photocentre offsets and model eccentricity correlate; no resolved primary albedo map follows.
2005–2035 ephemeris is relative to primary centre of light using500 constrained posterior draws, not centre-of-body/current scene; full machine table not fetched.
No spin locking, permanent face, local chemistry, geographic registration or independent calibration established.
Full publisher/raw products/posterior/code/figures and licence crosswalk remain open; specific arXiv CC BY-NC-SA4.0 is not CC BY.
